title: Record your bank's email alerts in a table
summary: When your bank emails you an alert, keep it in a data table and tell you on WhatsApp.
description: Every time your bank emails you a credit or debit alert, saves the alert's subject and text as a row in a data table in Taskiem (columns: received_at, subject, details) and tells you on the WhatsApp or Telegram you linked to Taskiem (or by email). The workflow gets its own email address: set your mailbox to forward your bank's alerts there (the workflow shows you how, step by step). Mail from anyone other than your bank's address is not taken. No bank login or mailbox password is needed.

params.name: bank_sender
params.title: Your bank's alert address
params.description: The address your bank's alerts come from (or just its domain, such as yourbank.com). Only mail from it is taken.

params.title: Alerts table
